title: Bayan Run 2026 Review: What the 2025 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Bayan Run 2026 Review | Balikpapan, East Kalimantan
meta_description: Bayan Run review: about 6,000 runners at Lapangan Merdeka, Balikpapan, on 12 October 2025, a route past the city's landmarks, and what to expect in 2026.
dek: Bayan Resources' corporate race filled Lapangan Merdeka in Balikpapan with about 6,000 runners in October 2025. Here is what that edition was like, ahead of the 2026 race.
verdict: Bayan Run is a big corporate city race in East Kalimantan. The 2025 edition, on Sunday 12 October, drew about 6,000 runners from across the province to Lapangan Merdeka in Balikpapan, over 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and a half marathon [1]. The route passed city landmarks including Tugu Monpera, Plaza Balikpapan and Tugu Beruang Madu [1]. It was run by the coal company PT Bayan Resources together with the regional army command, Kodam VI/Mulawarman, which also flagged it off [1]. If you live in East Kalimantan and want a well-attended race with a half marathon, it is a good one.

sections.heading: The 2025 Edition
paragraphs: About 6,000 runners from across East Kalimantan took part on Sunday 12 October 2025, starting from Lapangan Merdeka in Balikpapan [1]. The race marked the 17th anniversary of PT Bayan Resources and the 80th anniversary of the TNI, and was organised with Kodam VI/Mulawarman under the theme Keep Moving, Keep Strong [1].

There were four categories: 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km and the 21 km half marathon [1]. The regional army command's chief of staff flagged off the race, and there was a TNI-Polri category for military and police runners [1].

sections.heading: The Route and the Atmosphere
paragraphs: The route took runners past Balikpapan landmarks including Tugu Monpera, Plaza Balikpapan and Tugu Beruang Madu [1]. After the race there was entertainment and door prizes [1].
This is a community and corporate event more than a competitive one, and the reporting reflects that: it covers the partners and the crowd more than the course, timing or results.

sections.heading: Should You Enter the 2026 Race?
paragraphs: If you are in Balikpapan or nearby, yes. A field of about 6,000 and a city-centre route give it atmosphere, and the range of distances suits families as well as half-marathon runners.
If you care about the course details, check the 2026 route map and timing arrangements when they are published, because the 2025 reporting does not cover them.
This review is compiled from published reporting on the 2025 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.
